dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Razor! Razor! ...Hmm, he's not here either...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, did you see Razor on your way here?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: No, no, it's just... Well, actually, it is kinda urgent...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When he visited the city a few days back, he was going to have some cake with Klee, but the shops were all out and he didn't get any.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Klee got up early this morning and bought some so she could go to Wolvendom and give it to him.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: She would've run off all alone, had Captain Kaeya not discovered and stopped her.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It's way too dangerous for her to go out there all alone.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: To make sure she stays put at headquarters, I've promised to deliver a crayon drawing she made and the cake to Razor.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But I've nearly covered the whole area, and still haven't found him yet...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: *sigh* Alright, Amber, breathe... You can't give up yet. If you don't find Razor soon, the cake will get stale!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Okay, I'll get up in the air and look for him one more time. Seeya!

choices.text: Is there something urgent you need to talk to him about?
